definition: The grammatical correctness and naturalness of generated text from a purely linguistic standpoint, independent of factual accuracy or relevance.
details: Fluency was a major challenge for earlier generation systems but has become largely solved by modern LLMs, shifting evaluation focus toward correctness, relevance, and reasoning quality instead.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. Think of it this way: The grammatical correctness and naturalness of generated text from a purely linguistic standpoint, independent of factual accuracy or relevance. And here is the clever part: Fluency was a major challenge for earlier generation systems but has become largely solved by modern LLMs, shifting evaluation focus toward correctness, relevance, and reasoning quality instead. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Fluency.
